summary: Implementation plan for the complete, production-ready white-label skin care clinic website and admin booking engine (Lumina Skin Clinic). Covers the 4-file architecture (index.js, admin.js, vercel.json, package.json), 80:15:5 color & surface system, Google Business profile reviews widget with animated counting, full booking pipeline with double-booking prevention, floating contact dock, and secure HMAC-authenticated admin dashboard.
